description: Start your day with a mug that speaks in wry, retro humor. This glossy ceramic cup wraps a repeating vintage comic-style design around a deep green backdrop, pairing cheeky, text-driven quips with mid-century smiling faces. It makes for an easy conversation starter at the kitchen table, the office desk, or during lazy weekend coffee. The smooth C-handle and shiny finish feel familiar and comfortable in hand, while the bold colors make the print pop.
